body.x: Fitbit(www.fitbit.com), a manufacturer of activity trackers and wireless-enabled wearable devices, unveiled Fitbit Surge at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Fitbit Surge provides accurate tracking of steps taken, distance traveled, calories burned and floors climbed with its bright, OLED display showing time of day and real-time stats. Its automatic sleep detection monitors sleep quality using motion analysis to understand sleep and wake times. It also features a silent, vibrating alarm, and has caller ID to helps users stay connected to incoming calls. The wristband vibrates and shows the caller’s name or number when a smartphone is nearby.It is made high-quality, water-resistant, comfortable new textured wristband design with an improved clasp, and lasts up to seven days with one charge.
